purpose: A reversible, no-download evaluation registry. Presence here is not approval to install, activate, publish, or replace a current default.
global_adoption_gates: Record an exact model revision or digest, artifact provenance, license, and rollback target.
Use a fresh workload-specific sidecar environment when the candidate is not served by the existing Ollama runtime.
Run only after chat, World, TTS, and other heavy GPU work are stopped; verify free VRAM before and after.
Pass a short smoke test, a one-hour soak, and a four-hour supervised soak without resource leakage or state corruption.
Compare against the rollback baseline on the same private, authorized fixtures.
Do not promote benchmark output into autobiographical memory, canon, identity evidence, or source-media truth.
Require explicit owner review before changing any default or enabling an inactive capability.

ollama_fixture_suite.interpretation: Mechanical fixture success is screening evidence only, not an adoption decision.

ollama_request_profile_policy.reasoning_trace_policy: Record counts and character lengths when returned, but do not copy hidden thinking text into the benchmark report.

license.constraints: Custom community license and acceptable-use policy; review before redistribution or external deployment.

adoption_gates: Preserve the installed artifact unchanged, but never select, test, probe, or use it as an automatic fallback under the current owner decision.
Any future activation requires a new explicit owner decision after Qwen 3.5 is found completely unusable.

license.constraints: Preserve license and notices; independently review model-card usage guidance.

runtime.hardware_fit: plausible_unverified; begin at 4096 to 8192 context because artifact size excludes KV cache and runtime overhead

operational.purpose: Kira operational, persona, JSON, tool, and memory-honesty contracts need visible answers within the fixed output budget.

reasoning.purpose: Explicit opt-in for a future reasoning-mode benchmark; not the operational Kira contract default.
reasoning.interpretation: Keep the same fixed fixture budget. A length stop or empty visible answer is recorded as evidence, never worked around by weakening the contract.

adoption_gates: Verify the observed Ollama version can run the installed artifact without changing the server or pulling anything.
Use the operational request profile with top-level think=false for Kira contract screening; reasoning mode must remain an explicit separate run.
Pass Kira identity, persona, tool/JSON, memory-honesty, privacy-boundary, and no-invented-capabilities checks.
Measure 4K, 8K, and 16K context separately; do not infer that the advertised maximum context is practical here.
For images or sampled video frames, measure grounding errors and never auto-promote descriptions to memory or canon.

license.constraints: Preserve license and notices; independently review the selected checkpoint model card.

adoption_gates: Demonstrate a material VRAM or latency advantage over Qwen3.5-9B on the same owned image and sampled-video fixtures.
Measure OCR exactness, temporal-order mistakes, spatial grounding, and hallucinations on absent text.

license.constraints: OpenAI usage policy also applies; the Harmony response format must be integrated correctly.

runtime.hardware_fit: edge_of_16gb_memory_guidance; CPU offload and no concurrent GPU workload expected

adoption_gates: Verify Harmony roles, tool calls, and visible-answer extraction before judging response quality.
Reject if it cannot fully unload, causes sustained CPU offload, or leaves insufficient headroom for safe operation.

license.constraints: Generated audio contains the project's PerTh watermark; preserve provenance and use authorized references only.

adoption_gates: Retain the exact current package and voice references as rollback evidence.
Do not use voice output as identity authorization or proof of an exact likeness.

license.constraints: Generated audio contains the project's PerTh watermark; preserve provenance and use authorized references only.

adoption_gates: Add a reversible adapter for ChatterboxTurboTTS without modifying the rollback runtime.
Pass blind owner similarity review, name pronunciation, prosody, reference-tail leakage, repetition, first-audio latency, real-time factor, and unload tests.

license.constraints: Generated audio contains the project's PerTh watermark; preserve provenance and use authorized references only.

adoption_gates: Demonstrate a reviewed studio-quality or multilingual gain over Turbo and the rollback model.
Pass language switching, accent retention, code-switching, long-form continuity, and VRAM cleanup checks.

license.constraints: Preserve license and notices; use authorized voice references only.

runtime.hardware_fit: plausible_unverified; Windows FlashAttention availability must not be assumed

adoption_gates: Beat Chatterbox on the same authorized references without reference-tail leakage, hallucinated speech, or worse cleanup.
Record performance both with and without any optional acceleration that is actually available on Windows.

license.constraints: Turbo is transcription-focused; use an appropriate multilingual model for translation.

adoption_gates: Measure WER and CER for proper nouns, accents, noise, music, overlap, silence, long media, and timestamps.
Keep diarization and speaker identity as separate untrusted problems.

license.constraints: Preserve license and notices; timestamp coverage varies by aligner and language.

adoption_gates: Compare with Whisper on the identical audio corpus and timestamp contract.
Reject any model that hallucinates text on silence or conflates transcription with speaker identity.

license.constraints: Preserve license and notices; language data files must be tracked separately.

adoption_gates: Retain as a deterministic comparison and fallback.
Always preserve the original document and source-to-sidecar traceability.

license.constraints: Preserve license and notices; verify individual bundled dependency and model terms.

adoption_gates: Compare character and word error, page completeness, rotation, blur, low-resolution scans, blank pages, and throughput against Tesseract.
Do not overwrite originals or accept generative reconstruction as source truth.

license.constraints: Accelerated serving backends have Windows limitations; verify checkpoint and dependency terms.

adoption_gates: Use only if tables, formulas, or page layout justify the extra stack.
Measure reading order, hallucinated fields, tables, formulas, page completeness, and Windows stability.

license.constraints: Review third-party components and weights separately; enhanced pixels are generated estimates, not recovered facts.

adoption_gates: Operate on copies and label every result as an enhanced derivative.
Measure controlled-downsample quality, tiling seams, facial and texture invention, OCR before and after, and human side-by-side review.
